- Stem rot/necrosis occurring at the crown/soil level

**Differential diagnosis:**
- **Southern Blight** (Sclerotium rolfsii): Classic presentation — white mycelial mat at soil line + small, round sclerotia (starting white, maturing to tan/dark brown-black). Infection at the stem base near soil is hallmark.
- **Sclerotinia Timber Rot**: Also white mycelium + sclerotia, but sclerotia tend to be larger and more irregular/elongated.

The small, round, dark sclerotia with white cottony mycelium concentrated at the stem base at soil level is the textbook presentation of **Southern Blight**. The sclerotia appear mature (darkened), which is consistent.
